items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Then Louis Russell sent sent for me. They had sent for me.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was in Pittsburgh those years. Yeah. Your mother was in her 90s then. She looks
very well. Yeah. And here's another picture of Louis Russell. You see this Louis Russell
here. Oh, yes. I think I've seen that picture. Let's see. Is Nicholas in that group? I didn't recognize you. Albert, yeah. Albert's in that group. Oh, yeah.

items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's over in here. Yeah, Blue Russell. Yeah. Yeah, sure, I remember.

ctx.x: Wait a minute. Where's that big picture? See that big picture there? Show you the aluminum base. I had the first gold one. No, no, no, no, that one. The one with the whole band on it. Oh, yeah.
That's over in here. Yeah, Blue Russell. Yeah. Yeah, sure, I remember.
That's a metal base. That's a metal base.
